race.comment: HIDDEN WITNESS (10) hasn't quite been able to crack it this time in, but has logged three second placings, including a last-start effort by a handy one from the McEvoy yard. Only needs to hold that form to be the testing material. BECAUSEYOU'RE MINE (5) finished 1.2 lengths away in fourth last time out over 1000m at Warrnambool when first up from a spell, which was in BM62 grade. Tackles a longer journey this time, but this is easier and should be in the finish. ARTPARK (9) knuckled down strongly to get within a neck of the winner in second last start over 1200m at Warracknabeal. Deep into the prep now, but last start showed he's going well enough to play a key role in a race like this. BRING THE THUNDER (1) has been beaten less than two lengths his past three starts, including a neck second to Nasraawy three back, which is awesome form for this. COSMIC CHARGER (2) ran his best race of the prep last start, so might be ready to go on with it.
